mechanism: Celecoxib may increase chlorpromazine levels through CYP2C9 inhibition and both drugs increase GI bleeding risk and CNS depression; chlorpromazine may lower seizure threshold while NSAIDs can increase fluid retention affecting antipsychotic efficacy.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine side effects (sedation, orthostasis, extrapyramidal symptoms); assess GI risk and consider gastroprotection; maintain adequate hydration and monitor renal function; use lowest effective celecoxib dose or consider alternative analgesic.
